description: Source code for combining and diffing multiple file versions in a version control system, including functions for path comparison, diff generation, and handling merge scenarios.

classes.name: combine_diff_path
classes.description: Represents a combined diff path with multiple parent versions and associated metadata.

classes.name: lline
classes.description: Represents a line that was lost from a parent during diffing.

classes.name: plost
classes.description: Tracks lines lost from a parent before coalescing.

classes.name: sline
classes.description: Represents a line surviving in the merge result, including lost lines and flags.

classes.name: combine_diff_state
classes.description: Maintains state during diff combination, including line numbers and line data.

methods.name: compare_paths
methods.description: Compares two file paths considering directory modes.

methods.name: filename_changed
methods.description: Checks if a filename change indicator ('R' or 'C') is present.

methods.name: intersect_paths
methods.description: Computes the intersection of paths across multiple diff states.

methods.name: coalesce_lines
methods.description: Finds the longest common subsequence of lines to coalesce changes.

methods.name: grab_blob
methods.description: Retrieves file content blobs from the repository, applying text conversions if needed.

methods.name: append_lost
methods.description: Appends a lost line to the list of lost lines in a line object.

methods.name: show_combined_header
methods.description: Displays header information for a combined diff, including file modes and paths.

methods.name: show_patch_diff
methods.description: Generates and displays a patch diff for a combined diff path.

methods.name: show_raw_diff
methods.description: Outputs raw diff information for a combined diff path.

methods.name: show_combined_diff
methods.description: Main function to display combined diffs based on user options.

methods.name: diff_tree_combined
methods.description: Computes combined diffs across multiple parent commits.

methods.name: diff_tree_combined_merge
methods.description: Handles diffing for a merge commit with multiple parents.

methods.name: combine_diff_path_new
methods.description: Creates a new combine_diff_path object with specified parameters.
